# Search your library

## Sub-features

- Text search across notes and titles; "/" focuses the field, Escape clears it.

## How to get to it (user POV)

Press `/` (or Ctrl+K) outside any text field and type in the Search your mind field. The grid updates a moment after typing stops. Escape clears the search and restores the grid.

## Driving it with `scripts/drive.mjs`

Needs two notes, `alpha probe` and `bravo probe` (see `capture-note.md`). Driven in this order:

```json
[
  {"label": "two cards", "expect": "[...document.querySelectorAll('article')].filter(a => /alpha probe|bravo probe/.test(a.textContent)).length === 2"},
  {"label": "slash", "key": "/"},
  {"label": "focused", "expect": "document.activeElement?.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Search your mind'"},
  {"label": "type", "fill": "input[aria-label='Search your mind']", "text": "alpha"},
  {"label": "only alpha", "expect": "(() => { const t = [...document.querySelectorAll('article')].map(a => a.textContent); return t.some(x => x.includes('alpha probe')) && !t.some(x => x.includes('bravo probe')); })()", "timeoutMs": 5000},
  {"label": "escape clears", "key": "Escape"},
  {"label": "both back", "expect": "document.querySelectorAll('article').length === 2", "timeoutMs": 5000},
  {"label": "slash", "key": "/"},
  {"label": "no match", "fill": "input[aria-label='Search your mind']", "text": "zzzzqqqq"},
  {"label": "empty state", "expect": "document.body.textContent.includes('Nothing surfaced yet.') && document.querySelectorAll('article').length === 0", "timeoutMs": 5000},
  {"label": "clear", "clickText": {"selector": "button", "text": "Clear search"}},
  {"label": "restored", "expect": "document.querySelectorAll('article').length === 2", "timeoutMs": 5000}
]
```

End state: nothing is stored by a search, so the proof is the visible card set at each step; read `items` once to show both notes were present and `archived = 0`.

## Gotchas

- Matching is whole-token full-text search over title, description, body, OCR text and metadata. `alp` does not match `alpha`; use full words. It works in a scratch library with no embedding model, where it is lexical only.
- Results update about 200 ms after typing stops, so give `expect` a timeout of a few seconds.
- The field is hidden at rest and expands on focus. `/` is ignored while an input has focus; press Escape first.
- The expanded field's hint reads `esc to close`. The result count and the "Save as Space" pill only show while the field is unfocused with a query set; not driven here.

# Capture a quote from the Add menu

## Sub-features

- Quote tile in the Add menu, with optional attribution and source URL.

## How to get to it (user POV)

Click Add at the foot of the sidebar and choose Quote. Type the quote, optionally add who said it and a source link, and press Save to library. The new card lands at the top of Everything.

## Driving it with `scripts/drive.mjs`

```json
[
  {"label": "open Add", "click": "button[data-tooltip='Add something to your library']"},
  {"label": "choose Quote", "clickText": {"selector": ".add-menu-tile", "text": "Quote"}},
  {"label": "quote field", "wait": "textarea[aria-label='Quote text']"},
  {"label": "type quote", "fill": "textarea[aria-label='Quote text']", "text": "verify quote text"},
  {"label": "attribution", "fill": "input[aria-label='Quote attribution']", "text": "Ada Probe, Notes"},
  {"label": "save", "click": "button.add-menu-save"},
  {"label": "card shows", "expect": "[...document.querySelectorAll('article')].some(a => a.textContent.includes('verify quote text'))", "timeoutMs": 10000},
  {"label": "dialog closed", "expect": "!document.querySelector('.add-menu-panel')"},
  {"label": "shot", "shot": "quote-saved.png"}
]
```

End state: the card is in the grid, and `items` has one row with `kind = 'quote'`, `title = 'verify quote text'`, `description = 'Ada Probe, Notes'`, `body = ''`, `source_label = 'Ada Probe'`, `archived = 0`, and `metadata.quoteText` equal to the quote.

## Gotchas

- The quote text is stored in `title` and the attribution in `description`, the reverse of a note, which keeps its text in `body`.
- Leave the source URL empty. A URL is normalised and becomes the `source_label` host, and the quote can then depend on external state.
- Same Add-menu rules as `capture-note.md`: the sidebar must be open.

# Search your library

## Sub-features

- Text search across notes and titles; "/" focuses the field, Escape clears it.
- Result count, and Save as Space, which turns the search into a Smart Space.

## How to get to it (user POV)

Press `/` (or Ctrl+K) outside any text field and type in the Search your mind field. The grid updates a moment after typing stops. Escape clears the search and restores the grid.

## Driving it with `scripts/drive.mjs`

Needs two notes, `alpha probe` and `bravo probe` (see `capture-note.md`). Driven in this order:

```json
[
  {"label": "two cards", "expect": "[...document.querySelectorAll('article')].filter(a => /alpha probe|bravo probe/.test(a.textContent)).length === 2"},
  {"label": "slash", "key": "/"},
  {"label": "focused", "expect": "document.activeElement?.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Search your mind'"},
  {"label": "type", "fill": "input[aria-label='Search your mind']", "text": "alpha"},
  {"label": "only alpha", "expect": "(() => { const t = [...document.querySelectorAll('article')].map(a => a.textContent); return t.some(x => x.includes('alpha probe')) && !t.some(x => x.includes('bravo probe')); })()", "timeoutMs": 5000},
  {"label": "escape clears", "key": "Escape"},
  {"label": "both back", "expect": "document.querySelectorAll('article').length === 2", "timeoutMs": 5000},
  {"label": "slash", "key": "/"},
  {"label": "no match", "fill": "input[aria-label='Search your mind']", "text": "zzzzqqqq"},
  {"label": "empty state", "expect": "document.body.textContent.includes('Nothing surfaced yet.') && document.querySelectorAll('article').length === 0", "timeoutMs": 5000},
  {"label": "clear", "clickText": {"selector": "button", "text": "Clear search"}},
  {"label": "restored", "expect": "document.querySelectorAll('article').length === 2", "timeoutMs": 5000}
]
```

End state: nothing is stored by a search, so the proof is the visible card set at each step; read `items` once to show both notes were present and `archived = 0`.

Save as Space, driven as a separate run (blurring keeps the query; Escape would clear it):

```json
[
  {"label": "slash", "key": "/"},
  {"label": "type", "fill": "input[aria-label='Search your mind']", "text": "alpha"},
  {"label": "only alpha", "expect": "document.querySelectorAll('article').length === 1 && document.querySelector('article').textContent.includes('alpha probe')", "timeoutMs": 5000},
  {"label": "blur", "expect": "(() => { document.activeElement.blur(); return true; })()"},
  {"label": "count", "expect": "document.querySelector('.capture-bar').textContent.includes('1 result')", "timeoutMs": 5000},
  {"label": "Save as Space", "clickText": {"selector": "button", "text": "Save as Space"}},
  {"label": "name prefilled", "expect": "document.querySelector(\"input[aria-label='Space name']\")?.value === 'alpha'", "timeoutMs": 5000},
  {"label": "create", "clickText": {"selector": "button[type=submit]", "text": "Create Space"}},
  {"label": "row exists", "wait": "button[aria-label='Rename alpha']"}
]
```

End state: `spaces` has one row with `kind = 'smart'` and `query = '{"text":"alpha"}'`. The new Space opens showing only the matching card.

## Gotchas

- Matching is whole-token full-text search over title, description, body, OCR text and metadata. `alp` does not match `alpha`; use full words. It works in a scratch library with no embedding model, where it is lexical only.
- Results update about 200 ms after typing stops, so give `expect` a timeout of a few seconds.
- The field is hidden at rest and expands on focus. `/` is ignored while an input has focus; press Escape first.
- The expanded field's hint reads `esc to close`. The result count and the "Save as Space" pill only show while the field is unfocused with a query set; not driven here.

# Spaces

## Sub-features

- Add a Space (Smart or Regular), rename it, delete it. Items are kept when a Space is deleted.
- File an item into a Regular Space from the item overlay.

## How to get to it (user POV)

Click the plus beside Spaces in the sidebar. Name it, choose Smart (the default, stores the current search as its query) or Regular (holds items you file by hand), and press Create Space. The new Space opens at once and a Regular one is empty. To file an item, open it and use Move to Space in the footer; that menu appears only when a Regular Space exists. Rename (pencil) and delete (X) sit on the Space row.

## Driving it with `scripts/drive.mjs`

Needs two notes (see `capture-note.md`). Driven in three runs; the Space name field alone does nothing until Create Space is clicked.

```json
[
  {"label": "add Space", "click": "button[aria-label='Add a Space']"},
  {"label": "name field", "wait": "input[aria-label='Space name']"},
  {"label": "name", "fill": "input[aria-label='Space name']", "text": "Verify A"},
  {"label": "Regular", "clickText": {"selector": "label", "text": "Regular"}},
  {"label": "create", "clickText": {"selector": "button[type=submit]", "text": "Create Space"}},
  {"label": "row exists", "wait": "button[aria-label='Rename Verify A']"},
  {"label": "back to Everything", "clickText": {"selector": "button", "text": "Everything"}},
  {"label": "open a card", "expect": "(() => { const a = [...document.querySelectorAll('article.library-card')].find(a => a.textContent.includes('bravo probe')); if (!a) return false; a.click(); return true; })()"},
  {"label": "overlay", "wait": "section[role='dialog'] button[aria-label='Close details']"},
  {"label": "Move to Space", "click": "button[aria-label='Move to Space']"},
  {"label": "file it", "clickText": {"selector": "[role='menuitemcheckbox']", "text": "Verify A"}},
  {"label": "close menu", "key": "Escape"},
  {"label": "close overlay", "click": "button[aria-label='Close details']"},
  {"label": "rename", "click": "button[aria-label='Rename Verify A']"},
  {"label": "rename input", "wait": "input[aria-label='Rename Verify A']"},
  {"label": "new name", "fill": "input[aria-label='Rename Verify A']", "text": "Verify B"},
  {"label": "commit", "key": "Enter"},
  {"label": "renamed", "expect": "[...document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-pressed]')].some(b => b.textContent.includes('Verify B'))"},
  {"label": "delete", "click": "button[aria-label='Delete Verify B']"},
  {"label": "gone", "expect": "![...document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-pressed]')].some(b => b.textContent.includes('Verify'))"},
  {"label": "items kept", "expect": "document.querySelectorAll('article').length === 2", "timeoutMs": 5000}
]
```

Split the file after "create" and after "close overlay" to read the database between runs. End state, read from `library.sqlite3` readonly: after create, `spaces` has one row with `kind = 'regular'` and `query = '{}'`; after filing, `space_items` has one row linking the Space `id` to the item id; after delete, `spaces` and `space_items` are empty and both `items` rows still have `archived = 0`.

## Gotchas

- Everything and Space rows are different: a Space row is `button[aria-pressed]`, the Everything row has no `aria-pressed`, so select it with `clickText` on `button`.
- Rename and delete are hover-revealed but `click` works on them without hovering. There is no delete confirmation. Delete is `button[aria-label='Delete <name>']`; `data-tooltip='Delete Space'` matches the first row only.
- `Rename <name>` is both the pencil button's and the input's `aria-label`; prefix the selector with `button` or `input`.
- A Smart Space cannot hold hand-filed items, so Move to Space lists Regular Spaces only. A Smart Space made while the search box has text takes that text as its query.

content.text:
I've added all three to [PR #202](https://github.com/Squidys-Tools/inkling/pull/202) and re-driven each one live. I also fixed the PR description.

**Added and driven**
- **Quote capture:** new `capture-quote.md`. The row checks out in the database. The quote text lands in `title` and the attribution in `description`, the reverse of a note.
- **Search result count and Save as Space:**
  - Save as Space opens the Space form prefilled with the query. Creating it stores a Smart Space with query `{"text":"alpha"}`, and the Space shows only the one matching card.
  - To keep the query while unfocused, blur the field. Escape would clear it.
  - The result count is an animated digit roll, so its text reads like `01231`. The doc says to assert on the `1 result` bar text instead.
- **`spaces` row after rename:** the name changed and `updated_at` moved. After delete, `spaces` was empty and both items remained.
- **Not mapped:** `features/README.md` now lists Link, File, Screen and deep-link capture with the reason for each.

**Caveat:** I proved the rename read on the Smart Space from Save as Space, not the Regular one from the earlier run. The `name` and `updated_at` columns work the same way for both, but the doc's `Verify B` example wasn't read back from the database.

**PR description:** my first `gh pr create` used `--body -`, which set the body to a literal `-`. The write-up from my earlier summary never reached the PR. I've replaced it with the full description, including the new coverage.

The new scratch run is torn down, and its evidence is in `.artifacts/verify-inkling/maintain-run/`. I haven't watched PR #202's checks.
